description: The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a confirmation dialog asking "Keep these display settings?" with a 12-second countdown as the user configures multiple displays (1, 2, and 3) in duplicate mode.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor configuration with display 1 as the main screen and displays 2|3 duplicated, with various display options and brightness controls visible.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a "Keep these display settings?" confirmation dialog with a 13-second countdown while the user configures a multi-monitor setup with displays labeled 1, 2, and 3.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open on the Display settings page, showing a "Keep these display settings?" confirmation dialog with a 10-second countdown, while the user is configuring a multi-monitor setup with 3 displays (duplicating desktop on monitors 2 and 3).

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display with a "Keep these display settings?" confirmation dialog appearing after the user configured a multi-monitor setup with displays 2 and 3 duplicated, and the cursor is hovering over the "Keep changes" button.
